name: Lara Cat Dry Food – Junior 950g
shortDescription: Lara Junior Dry Cat Food Chicken is a complete and balanced dry food specially formulated to meet the nutritional needs of kittens from weaning up to 12 months of age. Made with delicious chicken-flavoured crunchy kibbles, this wholesome recipe provides the essential nutrients growing kittens need to develop into healthy, active adult cats.
description: Carefully balanced with essential vitamins and minerals, Lara Junior supports healthy growth, strong bones, muscle development, and overall wellbeing during your kitten's most important stage of life. The small-sized kibbles are specially designed for easy chewing and digestion, making every meal both nutritious and enjoyable. Key Features Complete and balanced nutrition for kittens up to 12 months old Delicious chicken flavour that kittens love Small, crunchy kibbles designed for easy chewing Supports healthy growth and development Enriched with essential vitamins and minerals Helps build strong bones, teeth, and muscles Highly digestible recipe for growing kittens Suitable for everyday feeding Benefits Supports healthy growth during the first year of life Provides essential nutrients for developing muscles and bones Promotes overall health and vitality Easy-to-eat kibble size for young kittens Delicious taste encourages healthy eating habits Delivers complete daily nutrition for growing kittens Feeding Guide Feed according to your kitten's age, weight, and activity level. Divide the daily feeding amount into several small meals throughout the day. Always provide fresh, clean drinking water alongside every meal. Storage Instructions Store in a cool, dry place and reseal the bag after opening to maintain freshness and preserve flavour. Why Choose Lara Junior Dry Cat Food Chicken? Lara Junior Dry Cat Food Chicken is specially developed to give kittens the complete nutrition they need for a healthy start in life. With a delicious chicken flavour, small easy-to-chew kibbles, and a balanced blend of essential vitamins and minerals, it supports healthy growth, strong bones, muscle development, and overall wellbeing, helping your kitten thrive through every stage of its first year.
